title: Electric Fat Tire Bikes

metaDescription: Shop fat tire electric bikes for sale at Umbra Electric — 6 curated all-terrain models for sand, snow and trail, financing and worldwide shipping.
seoIntro: Wide, low-pressure tires make an electric fat tire bike the right call for sand, snow and loose off-road terrain where a standard-width tire loses grip. Compare a fat tire electric bike against our standard-width commuter and mountain lines if you're not sure which fits your terrain.
